name: prometheus-essential-replay
description: Every target of verity.json, served the record job's session by tools/cm-replay on loopback instead of Essential's servers: no account, no Mojang sign-in, so no rate limit. prometheus.verity.cm points Essential at the replay server (VerityChecks.redirect) and minecraft.api.session.host its pre-connect Mojang join at the replay server's stub.
